title: Grateful Dead Live at Eureka Municipal Auditorium on 1968-01-20
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a jazzy, psychedelic Jan 1968 set with standout Clementine and a soaring Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crystal‑clear, crisp soundboard material that lets the band’s swinging, jazz‑inflected playing shine.  Listeners repeatedly cite the rare “Clementine” performance and a short but spectacular Dark Star as highlights, noting the set’s seamless flow despite its brevity.  Overall the show is described as high‑energy and essential for any Deadhead.

ai_rating.rationale: Over thirty 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the musical performance (jazzy, high energy, standout tracks) and the soundboard recording quality (crisp, clean). Only a few low or mixed ratings mention missing material, which does not outweigh the strong consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean and well‑balanced; reviewers call it the best‑sounding file archived. Minor complaints about Dark Star fading early and some missing intro/outro material.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a smooth, almost continuous flow – “like one long song” – despite the short overall length; the set feels cohesive and highly engaging.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised enthusiastically (review titled "Phil!!!"); noted for strong playing on this date.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard work highlighted in Clementine with a jazzy, My Favorite Things vibe; organ/keys praised as swinging and melodic.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum rhythm described as swinging, jazz‑inflected and driving the set’s groove.
